metadata.description: Black Box Safety internal Claude plugins — the state sales desk, the website pipeline, and the Business Central back office.

plugins.name: bbs-ops
plugins.description: Maintain the BBS website end to end — price list to live product page. Catalog intake and import, contract pricing, variant families, enrichment, storefront pages, quote-bot lane tuning, QA and cross-sell.

plugins.name: bbs-sales
plugins.description: The California state quote desk, end to end: log an inbound RFQ, pull items out of whatever the agency sent, check BPO eligibility, price it through the Grainger punch-out or vendor sourcing, build the customer quote, and fill the CDCR and CA compliance packets. Plus Grainger promo pages and federal deck copy.

plugins.name: bbs-back-office
plugins.description: What happens after the bid is won: read the truth out of Business Central. Where an order stands, what a vendor still owes us, and what the deal actually earned once Grainger rebates are applied.
